'''Security Hub 038-A''' was a security station located in [[District 1327|Breaktown]] on [[Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Security Hub 038-A appears on Zakuul during "Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
